tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch11:11-6Suppose $P$ is an embedded hypersurface in a Riemannian manifold $(M, g)$ and $N$ is a unit normal vector field along $P$. Suppose the principal curvatures of $P$ with respect to $-N$ are bounded below by a constant $\lambda $, and the sectional curvatures of $M$ are bounded above by $-\lambda ^2$. Prove that $P$ has no focal points along any geodesic segment with initial velocity $N_p$ for $p \in P$. \end{exercise}
